facts.fact: KIX-SEEDS says its pilot in the communes of Manga and Bingo follows over 12,000 pupils individually by unique identifier on a digital platform with modules for teachers' grades, school management and public statistics, with integration into the national SIGE still to come.
KIX-SEEDS says its KIX-DHIS2 module is an interoperability interface with the national DHIS2 system in its pilot platform.
